item.title: Bobcat: A Personal Link Directory
item.description: I built bobcat as a personal link directory—a single page to organize all the websites I actually use, inspired by the link directories of the late 90s like Yahoo and DMOZ.

item.title: About
item.description: This blog is a personal space for writing about topics I find interesting. Expect infrequent but substantive posts—quality over quantity, maybe once a month or so. Topics Things I write about: Math and Science: Explorations, explanations, and interesting problems Vintage Technology: Old audio equipment, video formats, retro computing Atari Computers: Programming, hardware, and the 8-bit era RC Car Racing: Kyosho cars, racing tips, and restoration projects Other Interests: Whatever else catches my attention About Me I’m a software developer with a background in embedded systems and C programming, branching out into other areas.
